summary: Tested order PDF and email (cliente/fornitore) and linking a BEM (goods receipt) to a passive invoice, with the quantity/price check. Backend: 18/19 new pytest pass, and the iteration_75 regression passes 20/20. With a local debug SMTP on 127.0.0.1:1025 the email arrived with the attachment Conferma_ordine_OC_1-2026.pdf, and email_inviate was recorded and shown in the dialog history. No real emails were sent. UI: every requested testid is present and works: ord-pdf, ord-conferma-pdf (cliente only), the email dialog prefilled with the cliente email or the fornitore PEC, the conferma/ordine toggle, the SMTP 400 error toast, and the send button disabled when the recipient is empty. bem-fattura-panel works: candidates, link, comparison rows (Prezzo diverso / OK), unlink. The BEM page shows 'Fattura X' or 'In attesa di fattura'. One real bug: deleting a passive invoice leaves its BEM still linked to it, and that BEM can then never be annulled.

critical.issue: Linked BEMs are not unlinked when the passive invoice is deleted. The BEM keeps passive_id/passive_numero of a document that no longer exists. POST /api/bem/{id}/annulla is then blocked with 'collegata alla fattura X: scollegala prima', and the user cannot unlink it because the invoice page is gone. The BEM also never shows up as a candidate again (passive_id is not null). Reproduce: test_28_delete_passive_unlinks_bem.

minor.issue: Lines are matched when the article code appears anywhere in the invoice description. A short code like 'A1' also matches 'A10', 'CA1X' and similar, which can pair lines wrongly. Match on whole words, e.g. a regex like \bcod\b.

If an invoice line has quantita but no prezzo_totale, f['prezzo_totale'] raises a KeyError (500). Lines parsed from SDI always have it, but manually or otherwise imported lines may not. Use f.get('prezzo_totale').
Returns 200 even when the BEM was not linked to that invoice (no modified_count check). Minor.

ui_bugs.issue: Annulled BEMs still show 'In attesa di fattura'. It should be hidden when status is annullato.
Switching between conferma and ordine fetches the preview again and overwrites any edits the user made to the recipient, subject or message.

issues: The comparison table sits in the narrow right column, so the 6 columns wrap a lot (code and description over 3 lines, esito wrapping). Consider full width under the invoice lines.

action_items: delete_passive: before deleting, run db.bem.update_many({company_id, passive_id: pid}, {$set: {passive_id: None, passive_numero: None}}), or block the delete while BEMs are linked
confronto: match the code on whole words and use f.get('prezzo_totale')
Bem.jsx: hide 'In attesa di fattura' for annulled BEMs
Optional: keep user edits when switching conferma/ordine in the email dialog (only replace the subject and message if they were not edited)
critical_code_review_comments: Orphan BEM link after deleting a passive invoice (see above).
Code matching by substring is fragile with short codes.
tutto_ok ignores extra_fattura lines when the imponibile difference is 0. That is fine, but extra lines with 0 amount are not flagged in the summary.
seed_data_creation: The module creates a TEST_T76 company, parties, articles, orders, BEMs, passive invoices (via reg-veloce, with lines set in Mongo) and a session token test_session_t76_admin. Everything is cleaned at the end (company-scoped deleteMany across collections). All of it was removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with -n 0. T76_KEEP=1 T76_RUN=xxx keeps the data for UI checks. The UI login is the cookie session_token=test_session_t76_admin plus localStorage fe_company_id. In headless Chromium the PDF new tab stays at about:blank (blob PDF); the API returned 200 application/pdf, and the same pattern is used elsewhere in the app. The SMTP success path was tested with python3 -m smtpd DebuggingServer on 127.0.0.1:1025 (the test sets and then deletes the company SMTP).
